scsi_device.description: The path to the SCSI generic device representing the media changer (e.g., /dev/sg0, /dev/sg1).

nobarcode.description: If true, forces the loader to not request barcodes even if the loader is capable of reporting them.

invert.description: If true, inverts (flips) the media before inserting it into the drive or returning it to the storage slot.

noattach.description: If true, forces the regular media changer API even if the media changer incorrectly reported that it uses the 'ATTACHED' API.

commands.description: A list of robotics control commands to execute with mtx. Each item is a map containing 'command' (string) and optional 'args' (list of strings). Valid commands include status, inventory, load, unload, transfer, exchange, first, last, previous, next, position, eject, inquiry, and version.
